results.title: The phone's verse sheet
results.checks: On an iPhone 13, tapping John 3:3 brings up the old reader's sheet along the bottom in place of the tabs: a handle, ✕, 'John 3:3' and four cards Highlight · Save · Note · Copy, with 'Swipe up to see more'. A tap on the handle shows Share and Compare; a swipe down closes the sheet and the tabs come back. Highlight turns it into the colour strip with ← and the eraser; a colour highlights the verse and closes the sheet
results.note: cards Highlight · Save · Note · Copy in place of the tabs; the handle showed Share and Compare; a swipe down closed it; Highlight → the strip with ← and the eraser; a colour highlighted 3:3

results.title: The chapter header's actions
results.checks: At the top right of the chapter, in the old reader's order: ☆ Save chapter fills when tapped, Bookmark, Discover opens the Discover pane, Share opens the Share dialog with the chapter's link, and the orange Listen plays the recording and turns into Pause
results.note: header: Save chapter · Bookmark this chapter · Discover · Share · Listen; Save filled and cleared; Discover opened its pane; Share opened the dialog; Listen played and paused

results.title: Tab marks and the collapsed rail
results.checks: A bookmark on John 3 puts its ribbon on the tab's row, and Listen puts a speaker there while it plays. With the sidebar closed to its rail, the tab is the old reader's tile: 'JHN 3', the speaker, and a label that says it is playing audio
results.note: row: ribbon and speaker; rail tile 'JHN 3', 'JHN 3 — playing audio'; the speaker went with Pause

results.title: The phone's swipe shows the next chapter
results.checks: On an iPhone 13 at John 3, dragging the page to the left moves it with the finger and John 4 slides in beside it with its title and text; letting go part-way springs back to John 3, and a full swipe lands on John 4. Dragging right from John 4 shows John 3 coming in from the left
results.note: mid-drag John 4 at 248px; a short drag stayed; a full one landed on John 4; dragging right brought John 3 in at -248px
